name: Anniversaries
overview: Scripture highlights the value of relationships and the significance of honoring time in a way that reflects personal conviction and love. Proverbs emphasizes the blessing and favor found in a godly marriage, while Ecclesiastes affirms the strength and reward in partnership. Romans teaches that the observance of special days, such as anniversaries, is a matter of individual conscience, encouraging believers to be fully assured in their own minds. Above all, Colossians reminds us that love is the essential bond that perfects and unites relationships, underscoring the Christ-centered foundation for commemorating milestones.
